context_requirements: Expression of the relevant GPCR(s) for the drug class on the cell line
Intact G-protein signaling (Gq/Gi/Gs) and downstream MAPK/NFAT/NF-kB pathways
For some responses, serum or autocrine factors may be required
Cell lines with low receptor expression or defective downstream signaling may show little response
falsifiers: No induction of immediate early genes (FOS, EGR1, JUN) at 6 h in any cell line
No change in NF-kB or NFAT target genes at 6 h
No late proliferative or inflammatory gene changes at 24 h
Responses are uniform across all nine lines regardless of receptor expression

evidence.supports: GPCR agonists (angiotensin II, endothelin-1, phenylephrine) activate NF-kB and ASK1 in cardiomyocytes
Thrombin, a GPCR agonist, induces NFATc1 nuclear translocation and proliferation in vascular smooth muscle cells
Thrombin induces NFAT-dependent IL-6 expression and motility in vascular smooth muscle cells
Angiotensin II induces PAI-1 (SERPINE1) via JNK in cardiac cells
A Gq-linked GPCR agonist attenuates glucocorticoid-dependent transcription in A549 and BEAS-2B cells
